summary: Twelve metres of roundabout exit kerb by a bus stop; nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Houses are 46 m or more away, but the kerb is exposed to a motorway-style road.
drivers.access_and_room: The line follows the roundabout's outer edge into the exit lane; no verge, so a van would block it.
drivers.traffic: Adjacent to a multi-lane arterial; roundabout and bus stop on the same stretch.
drivers.convention: Bus Zone sign 14 m from the kerb line; no parked cars.

sun_shade: Open to sun; trees shade the north side.
